problem.title: Your candidate database is worth more than you think — but less usable than it should be.
problem.subtitle: Agencies pay for new sourcing campaigns while qualified candidates already sit in their own database. Years of accumulated records quietly decay until searching them stops feeling worth it.

item1.title: Outdated resumes
item1.description: CVs collected years ago no longer reflect what candidates can do today — so your searches return stale answers.

item2.title: Missing contact and profile information
item2.description: Profiles without an email, phone number, location or skills can't be contacted or matched when a role opens.

item3.title: Duplicate candidate records
item3.description: The same person exists three times under slightly different names, splitting their history and cluttering every search.

item4.title: Qualified candidates buried in old data
item4.description: The right person for your current vacancy is often already in your database — invisible behind noise and outdated records.

dataQuality.label: Data Health
dataQuality.title: Know exactly what is usable — and what needs attention.
dataQuality.subtitle: Qorva evaluates every profile in your candidate library across four quality dimensions, so you can see what is ready to use and fix what isn't.

completeness.title: Completeness
completeness.description: Spot profiles missing critical information — email, phone number, role, skills or employment history — before they cost you a placement.

freshness.title: Freshness
freshness.description: See how recently each profile was updated: within the last six months, six to eighteen months ago, or older than eighteen months.

uniqueness.title: Uniqueness
uniqueness.description: Detect likely duplicate candidate profiles and duplicate CVs, so every search returns one clean record per person.

confidence.title: AI confidence
confidence.description: See how confident the AI extraction is for each parsed CV, so low-confidence records can be flagged for manual review.

dataQuality.action: Every issue is actionable: open the affected profiles, then re-analyse them, request updates from the candidates, archive them or remove duplicates — all from the same view.

refresh.label: Candidate Refresh
refresh.title: Refresh outdated profiles without manual follow-up.
refresh.subtitle: Instead of manually updating thousands of records, recruiters can ask candidates to confirm and refresh their own information.

step3.title: Candidates update themselves
step3.description: Each candidate receives a request and updates their own profile.

step4.title: Your database stays current
step4.description: Refreshed profiles flow back into your library, ready to search and match.

icp.label: Who it's for
icp.title: Built for boutique IT, engineering and specialist staffing agencies.
icp.subtitle: Qorva is designed for agencies that live in their candidate database — not for one-off hiring.

fit1.title: Teams of 2–30 recruiters
fit1.description: Big enough to have accumulated thousands of profiles over the years, small enough that nobody has time to clean them by hand.

fit2.title: Recurring, similar roles
fit2.description: You place the same kinds of profiles again and again — which means past candidates are often the fastest route to the next placement.

fit3.title: An ATS full of history
fit3.description: Years of CVs, notes and half-complete records sit in your ATS or recruitment CRM. Qorva works alongside it and turns that history into a searchable asset.

explainability.title: Explainable results

control.title: Recruiters stay in control

integrity.title: Controlled data access

privacy.title: Privacy-conscious by design

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

item1.question: What is the Data Health report?
item1.answer: Import your candidate library and Qorva analyzes it across completeness, freshness, duplicates and AI-extraction confidence. You get a clear view of which profiles are ready to use, which need attention, and where potential duplicates hide.

item2.question: Do I need an ATS or HR software to use Qorva?
item2.answer: No. Qorva is a standalone platform that works alongside whatever you use today. Export your CVs from your ATS or CRM, import them into Qorva, and start analyzing — no integrations or IT project needed.

item3.question: How quickly can I see results?
item3.answer: Right away. Create an account, import your resumes, and Qorva starts analyzing them immediately. Most teams see their first quality insights and matches within minutes of their first import.

item4.question: Can I define what matters most for each specific role?
item4.answer: Yes. You define the scoring rules — required skills, seniority level, experience domains — and Qorva ranks every candidate accordingly. Each score comes with a clear explanation so you always know why someone ranked where they did.

item5.question: Is candidate data secure?
item5.answer: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest and processed in isolated tenant spaces. Candidate data is never sold or shared with third parties, and can be deleted at any time on request — supporting your privacy obligations towards candidates.

item6.question: Is there a free trial?
item6.answer: Yes — 14 days, full access. Import real candidates from your own database and see exactly what Qorva can do before you commit to any plan.
